info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Reward Points Retrieval API enables developers to access detailed reward points information associated with specific banking accounts. By using the unique identifier, this endpoint retrieves data relevant to customers' reward points, enhancing user experience and informing decision-making. This API is particularly beneficial for customer service applications and mobile banking platforms that aim to provide personalized insights to account holders. Ideal for financial service providers, it enables seamless integration of reward points data into existing banking solutions.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific reward points account using its unique identifier ACC-200045. This operation provides insights into the account's balance, transaction history, and any applicable rewards.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the reward points account details for the specified account identifier 'ACC-200045'. Please ensure that the request is formatted correctly according to the schema provided.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the reward points account details.
